aiDisclosure.title: AI Disclosure & User Acknowledgment
aiDisclosure.intro:
Jesus Interactive is operated by Jesus Interactive Inc. ("we," "us," "our," or "Jesus Interactive"). Jesus Interactive uses artificial intelligence to generate conversational responses, spoken replies, sermon drafts, reflections, and other content. This Disclosure explains the nature of that technology, its limitations, and the legal agreement you accept by using the AI features.

By checking the box for this Disclosure, tapping "Agree and Continue," or continuing to use any AI-powered feature of the App, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to every part of this AI Disclosure and User Acknowledgment.

sections.heading: 1. Nature of the AI
sections.body:
The responses you receive in the App are generated by artificial intelligence models operated by third-party providers, not by a real person: Ask Jesus and the Gospel Translator are powered by Grok, built by xAI. Daily Devotions and the Sermon & Bible Study Writer are powered by Claude, built by Anthropic. Spoken replies use a synthesized, AI-generated voice, and spoken input is transcribed by speech recognition; both are provided by ElevenLabs. That voice is not the voice of Jesus Christ or of any real person. The portraits of Jesus shown in the App are artistic depictions created with AI image tools, not photographs or historical likenesses.

The AI is not Jesus Christ. The AI is not a real person. The AI is not divine, does not possess spiritual authority, and does not receive or transmit revelation from God.

The AI has been instructed to respond in a style inspired by the words and teachings of Jesus as recorded in the Christian Scriptures. This is a literary and educational simulation only. It is not a channel of communication with the living Christ, the Holy Spirit, or any spiritual being.

sections.heading: 2. What the AI Can and Cannot Do
sections.body:
The AI may:
- Generate responses in a conversational style consistent with biblical themes
- Reference or paraphrase Scripture (when properly configured)
- Help draft sermon outlines, reflections, or study notes
- Provide general encouragement drawn from Christian teachings

The AI cannot and does not:
- Speak with divine authority or as God
- Provide new revelation, prophecy, or personal messages from God
- Replace the Bible, prayer, worship, or the local church
- Offer pastoral counseling, spiritual direction, or sacramental ministry
- Diagnose, treat, or advise on medical, mental-health, legal, or financial matters
- Guarantee biblical accuracy on every response (AI systems can err, invent details, or misapply Scripture)

sections.heading: 3. Potential for Error and "Hallucinations"
sections.body:
Artificial intelligence systems sometimes produce inaccurate, incomplete, or fabricated information (commonly called "hallucinations"). This includes the possibility of:
- Incorrect or non-existent Bible references
- Theological statements that conflict with historic Christian orthodoxy
- Invented personal details or stories presented as fact
- Biased or incomplete interpretations of Scripture

You are solely responsible for verifying any biblical quotation, theological claim, or advice against the actual text of Scripture and the teaching of your church or pastor.

sections.heading: 4. Not a Substitute for Real Spiritual Care
sections.body:
Jesus Interactive is an educational and reflective tool only. It is not a substitute for:
- Reading and studying the Bible itself
- Personal prayer and worship
- Participation in a local church community
- Guidance from ordained pastors, priests, elders, or qualified spiritual directors
- Professional mental-health, medical, or crisis counseling

If you are experiencing emotional distress, thoughts of self-harm, or a spiritual crisis, please contact a trusted pastor, counselor, or emergency services immediately. In the United States you may call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).

sections.heading: 5. Data Sent to AI Providers
sections.body:
When you use AI features, the text of your messages (and limited conversation history needed for context) is transmitted to the specific third-party AI provider behind that feature so a response can be generated: xAI for Ask Jesus and the Gospel Translator, and Anthropic for Daily Devotions and the Sermon & Bible Study Writer. When you use voice features, your recorded speech (for voice input) or the reply text to be spoken (for voice replies) is sent to ElevenLabs.

By using the AI features you explicitly consent to this transmission. We do not sell your chat content. We do not use your private conversations to train third-party foundation models unless you give separate, explicit opt-in consent (which is not required to use the Service).

Further details are set out in our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 6. Labeling of AI Content
sections.body: AI-generated content within the App, including Ask Jesus replies, Daily Devotions reflections and prayers, Sermon Writer drafts, and Gospel Translator translations, is labeled as AI-generated. This Disclosure is always available from Settings.

sections.heading: 7. Reporting and Moderation
sections.body: The App includes in-app reporting and flagging tools. If you encounter content that is offensive, inaccurate, theologically problematic, or otherwise inappropriate, please use the report feature. We review reports and may remove or restrict content or accounts that violate our Terms of Service.

sections.heading: 8. Indemnity and Release (User Acknowledgment)
sections.body:
By using the AI features of Jesus Interactive, you agree to the following:

1. You understand and accept that all AI-generated content is a simulation only and is not the voice, words, or authority of Jesus Christ, God, or any divine being.

2. You agree that you will not treat any AI response as divine revelation, prophecy, personal guidance from God, or a substitute for Scripture, prayer, pastoral care, or professional advice.

3. You assume full responsibility for any decisions, actions, beliefs, or consequences that result from your use of or reliance on AI-generated content.

4. To the maximum extent permitted by law, you release, waive, and forever discharge Jesus Interactive and its agents, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of or related to: your use of the AI features; any AI-generated content; any reliance you place on that content; and any emotional, spiritual, psychological, financial, or other harm you claim resulted from the AI.

5. You agree to indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Jesus Interactive from and against any claims, damages, losses, liabilities, costs, and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) brought by you or any third party arising out of or related to your use of the AI features or your breach of this Acknowledgment.

6. This indemnity and release is intended to be as broad and inclusive as permitted under the laws of the State of California and shall survive the termination of your use of the App.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Disclosure
sections.body: We may update this AI Disclosure & User Acknowledgment from time to time. The "Last Updated" date at the top will reflect the most recent revision. When we make material changes, we will ask you to review and accept the updated version in the App. Continued use of the AI features after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised version.

sections.body:
If you have questions about this AI Disclosure or the AI features of Jesus Interactive, please contact us at:

Jesus Interactive Inc.
30875 Avenida Del Padre
Cathedral City, CA 92234, United States
Email: support@jesusinteractive.com

sections.heading: 2. Description of the Service

The AI is a simulation only. It is not Jesus Christ, not a real person, not divine, and not a source of revelation or pastoral authority. Full details are set out in the separate AI Disclosure & User Acknowledgment, which forms part of these Terms.

sections.heading: 3. No Account Required; Your Device
sections.body:

You are responsible for activity that takes place through the App on your device and for keeping your device secure.

If we introduce accounts in the future, you agree to provide accurate information, keep your login credentials secure, and notify us promptly of any unauthorized use.

We may suspend or restrict access, including by device identifier, where we reasonably believe these Terms have been violated or where there is a security or legal risk.

sections.heading: 4. Subscriptions, Purchases, and Billing
sections.body:

Payment Processing: All payments are processed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play). We do not collect or store your payment card details. Subscription status is managed through our subscription service provider, RevenueCat, which receives your device identifier and purchase records from Apple or Google so your plan can be unlocked.

Auto-Renewal: Paid subscriptions automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period through your Apple ID or Google Play account settings.

Free Trial: New users receive a free trial of full access (currently 5 days) that requires no payment and does not automatically turn into a paid subscription. If a store-managed free trial is ever offered with a subscription, you will be charged when that trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends.

Gift Plans: A gift plan gives its recipient access for the stated period and then ends automatically; it does not renew.

Pricing: Prices are displayed in the App and may vary by region and currency. We reserve the right to change prices with notice as required by the platform.

Refunds: Refund requests are handled according to the refund policies of Apple or Google. We do not control refund decisions.

Your purchase is also subject to the applicable Apple Media Services Terms or Google Play Terms of Service.

"User Content" means any content you submit, post, or transmit through the App, including chat messages, sermon drafts, testimonies, reactions, reports, and prayer requests.

Testimonies you publish on the testimony wall are visible to other users of the App and to our moderators.

We may remove or disable access to any User Content that we believe violates these Terms or is otherwise objectionable, at our sole discretion.

sections.heading: 7. Acceptable Use and Prohibited Conduct
sections.body:
You agree not to use the App to: violate any applicable law or regulation; infringe intellectual property, privacy, or publicity rights; harass, threaten, defame, or harm others; post content that is pornographic, excessively violent, hateful, or discriminatory; attempt to impersonate any person or entity (including claiming to be Jesus, God, or a spiritual authority); upload viruses, malware, or other harmful code; interfere with or disrupt the Service or servers; attempt to gain unauthorized access to any systems or accounts; use the AI features to generate content intended to deceive others about the nature of the AI; scrape, data-mine, or collect information about other users without consent; or engage in any activity that could damage our reputation or the reputation of the Christian faith as we reasonably determine.

We reserve the right to investigate and take appropriate action, including suspension or termination of access and reporting to law enforcement.

sections.heading: 8. AI-Generated Content -- Special Terms
sections.body: All AI-generated responses are subject to the AI Disclosure & User Acknowledgment. In addition: AI outputs are provided "as is" for personal reflection, education, and creative assistance only; you are solely responsible for evaluating and verifying any AI-generated content before relying on it; we do not guarantee that AI responses will be theologically accurate, free from error, or consistent with any particular Christian tradition; you may not present AI-generated content as divine revelation, prophetic utterance, or the actual words of Jesus Christ; and you may not use the AI to create content that promotes harm, illegal activity, or theological claims presented as authoritative new revelation.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro:
This Privacy Policy explains how Jesus Interactive Inc. ("we," "us," or "our") handles information when you use the Jesus Interactive mobile app (the "App"). It describes how the App actually works today.

In plain language:
- We do not sell your personal information.
- There is no email or password login. Your use of the App is tied to a random identifier created on your device.
- Your profile name and photo, journal, prayer notes, favorites, and Ask Jesus conversation history are stored on your device.
- Words you type or speak into AI and voice features are sent to those providers so the feature can work. Please do not treat those chats as a sealed confessional.
- If you publish on the testimony wall, other users and our moderators can see it.
- You can export or delete the data linked to your device from Settings.

By using the App you agree to the practices described in this Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the App.

sections.heading: 1. Information Stored Only on Your Device
sections.body:
Some information is kept only on your device and is not stored on our servers: your display name and profile photo, journal entries, prayer notes, favorites, highlights, saved sermons, app settings, and your Ask Jesus conversation history (kept so you can revisit it). The parts of a conversation needed to answer you are sent to the AI provider each time you send a message (see Section 3), but we do not keep a copy of your conversation history on our servers.

Your Emergency SOS contacts (names and phone numbers) are also stored only on your device until you tap the SOS button (see Section 6).

Deleting the App from your device deletes this on-device information.

sections.heading: 2. Information We Collect on Our Servers
sections.body:
Device identifier: The App creates a random device identifier and sends it with requests to our servers. We use it to link your content and history to your device, show you your own posts and plan history, prevent abuse, and delete your data when you ask. We do not ask for your name, email address, or password.

Content you choose to submit: testimonies you publish on the testimony wall, reactions, reports of content, plan history, support reports you send us, and your export and delete requests. If you include a name or other personal details in something you submit, it is stored or processed as part of that content. Please do not include secrets, other people's private information, or medical or financial details.

Usage information: basic events about how the App is used (for example, which features are opened), linked to your device identifier, so we can understand and improve the App. We do not use this for advertising.

Subscription information: your plan and plan changes, including events our subscription provider sends us (such as a cancellation).

Technical and security logs: our hosting provider records standard request logs, and we record security audit entries (for example, denied attempts to reach admin tools, moderation actions, and data-deletion events). These may include the time, the request, its outcome, your IP address, and your device identifier, and are used only for security, reliability, and abuse prevention.

sections.heading: 3. AI and Voice Features
sections.body:
When you use an AI or voice feature, the information needed for that request is sent to the provider behind it:
- Ask Jesus and the Gospel Translator: your message text and limited recent conversation history go to xAI (Grok).
- Daily Devotions and the Sermon & Bible Study Writer: your prompt text goes to Anthropic (Claude).
- Voice input and spoken replies: your recorded speech, or the reply text to be spoken, goes to ElevenLabs.

These providers process the data to return a response and handle it under their own terms, which may include keeping it for a limited time for safety and abuse monitoring. We do not sell your chat content, and we do not use your private conversations to train third-party AI models unless you give separate, explicit opt-in consent, which is never required to use the App. You can choose not to use AI or voice features at all.

sections.heading: 4. How We Use Information
sections.body:
We use the information described above to: provide the App's features, including AI and voice features, the testimony wall, reactions, reports, plan history, and Emergency SOS; unlock and manage subscriptions and gift plans; moderate reported content; honor export and delete requests; keep the App secure and prevent fraud and abuse; understand how the App is used so we can improve it; respond to support requests; and comply with the law.

We do not sell personal information, and we do not build advertising profiles.

sections.heading: 5. Our Server Database and Deleting Your Data
sections.body:
Information linked to your device identifier is stored in a hosted PostgreSQL database (Neon).

When you use the delete option in Settings, the App sends your device identifier and we delete the rows linked to it from our live database, including your posts, reactions, reports, and plan history. You can also export the data linked to your device from Settings.

Deletion does not immediately remove: hosting and security logs already written; backups that have not yet expired; content posted from a different device; copies other people have already saved or shared; requests already sent to an AI or voice provider; or purchase records held by Apple, Google, or RevenueCat.

sections.heading: 6. Emergency SOS
sections.body:
The Emergency SOS feature is optional. Your emergency contacts' names and phone numbers stay on your device until you tap the SOS button. At that moment only, the App captures a single location snapshot and sends it, together with your contacts' phone numbers and the alert message, to our servers so we can deliver the alert by text message through Twilio. Location is never collected in the background or tracked continuously.

We keep a minimal record of each alert sent: your device identifier, the time, and the location coordinates. We do not store your contacts' names or phone numbers.

sections.heading: 7. Service Providers and Other Disclosures
sections.body:
We use these providers to run the App: Vercel (hosting and logs); Neon (database); xAI and Anthropic (AI features); ElevenLabs (voice features); RevenueCat (subscription status); Resend (delivering support reports to our inbox); Twilio (Emergency SOS text messages); and Apple and Google (app distribution and payments). Each receives only what it needs to provide its service to us.

We may also disclose information when required by law or legal process, to protect the rights, property, or safety of our users or others, or as part of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, in which case this Policy continues to apply to your information.

sections.heading: 8. Subscriptions and Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play); we never receive your payment card details. Our subscription provider, RevenueCat, receives your device identifier and your purchase and subscription status from Apple or Google so your plan can be unlocked and kept current. Apple's and Google's privacy policies govern how they handle your payment information.

sections.heading: 9. Moderation and Admin Access
sections.body: A small number of authorized operators can use protected admin tools to review reported content and take action on it. Failed attempts to reach those tools and moderation actions are recorded in audit logs. Ordinary users have no admin access.

sections.heading: 10. Your Choices and Rights
sections.body:
You can: use the App without creating an account; export the data linked to your device from Settings; delete the data linked to your device from Settings; choose not to post on the testimony wall; and choose not to use AI, voice, or Emergency SOS features.

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or receive a copy of your personal information, to object to or restrict certain processing, and to withdraw consent. To make a request, email us (see Section 16) and include the device identifier shown on the export or delete screen if you can, since that is how your data is linked.

California residents: under the California Consumer Privacy Act (as amended by the CPRA), you have the right to know, delete, and correct personal information and to opt out of its sale or sharing. We do not sell or share personal information as those terms are defined, and we will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights.

Users in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, and Switzerland: we process your information to provide the App you ask for (contract), for our legitimate interests in keeping it secure and improving it, with your consent where required, and to meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: 11. Children
sections.body:
The App is not directed to children under 13 (or the higher age of digital consent where you live), and they may not use it. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete the data we can link to their device.

Spiritual conversation in this App is not a substitute for a parent, pastor, counselor, or emergency help.

sections.heading: 12. Data Retention
sections.body: Information linked to your device stays in our live database until you delete it or we remove it for moderation, abuse, or legal reasons, or if the App shuts down. Hosting and audit logs are kept for our providers' standard retention periods unless needed for an active security investigation, and backups expire on our database provider's schedule. Emergency SOS alert records are kept as described in Section 6. Information stored only on your device stays there until you delete it or the App.

sections.heading: 13. Security
sections.body: We protect information with encryption in transit (HTTPS) for all communication with our servers, short-lived access tokens, rate limiting, and restricted, audit-logged admin access. Our providers' API keys are kept on our servers and are never included in the App. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: 14. International Processing
sections.body: We and our providers may process information in the United States and other countries. If you use the App from outside the United States, your information may be processed in a country whose data-protection laws differ from yours.

sections.heading: 15. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We will update the "Last Updated" date when we change this Policy. When we make material changes, we will ask you to review and accept the updated Policy in the App before you continue. If we ever add accounts, new kinds of data collection, or new providers, we will update this Policy first.

sections.heading: 16. Contact Us
sections.body:
Jesus Interactive Inc.
30875 Avenida Del Padre
Cathedral City, CA 92234, United States
Email: support@jesusinteractive.com

For privacy requests, please put "Privacy Request" in the subject line and include enough information for us to find the data linked to your device.

We aim to respond within a few business days. If you are in crisis, please see our AI Disclosure for emergency resources rather than waiting for a reply here.
